title: Confirming HSC strong lens candidates with DESI Spectroscopy. II. Analysis of 80 galaxy-scale systems with lens redshifts above 0.8
summary: The total mass distribution of galaxies provides a sensitive probe of the fundamental physical processes governing galaxy evolution, including gas inflow/star formation, AGN/SN feedback, galaxy merging, and the nature of dark matter. State-of-the-art cosmological simulations have therefore made extensive predictions for the evolution of the total-mass density slope. Interestingly, their predictions diverge significantly at high redshift, primarily due to differences in how these key physical mechanisms are implemented. However, measurements of the total-mass structure evolution have been largely confined to low and intermediate redshifts, leaving the regime where model predictions differ most significantly (z>0.8) largely unexplored. In the first paper of this series, we reported the discovery of 84 candidate strong-lens systems with lens redshifts above 0.8. In this work, we perform lens modeling of the 80 galaxy-scale systems to assess their lensing nature. Of these, 71 systems (approximately 90%) exhibit clear lensing features that are well reproduced by our lens models and are therefore classified as secure strong lenses. Another eight systems are classified as probable (5) or possible (3) strong lenses, based on the prominence of their lensing features and the quality of the lens modeling. One system lacking reliable lensing features in current imaging data is classified as a non-lens. Our analysis nearly triples the number of known galaxy-scale strong lenses at z_lens > 0.8, making statistical studies of the total mass structure of high-redshift galaxies possible for the first time. This expanded sample provides an unprecedented opportunity to test the predictions of cosmological simulations and discriminate between competing physical prescriptions.

title: VENUS: Strong Lens Mass Models and Einstein Radii of 60 Galaxy Clusters
summary: We present the strong lens mass modeling result of 60 galaxy clusters targeted by Vast Exploration for Nascent, Unexplored Sources (VENUS), the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) multi-epoch Treasury program. We obtain refined mass models for the 60 clusters with the glafic software by fitting positions of $\sim 4500$ multiple images, $\sim 1150$ of which are newly identified multiple images with help of multi-band JWST images. Each cluster contains typically $\sim 50$ multiple images, thanks to the selection of target clusters based on their high lensing strengths. We validate our models with the Jackknife method. The median Einstein radius is $\sim 30''$ and the distribution of the Einstein radii extends out to $\sim 60''$ for the source redshift of 9, which confirms that their lensing strengths are indeed among the highest known to date. For the source redshift of 9, we identify MACS J0717.5+3745, MACS J0600.1$-$2008, and PLCK G287.0+32.9 as clusters with the largest Einstein radii as well as the largest areas of the high-magnification ($|μ|>10$) regions. We find that the observed Einstein radii of VENUS clusters are fully compatible with the standard cold dark matter model.

title: Euclid Quick Data Release (Q1). Refining the strong lens sample with Space Warps crowd-sourced science
summary: We demonstrate the efficacy of crowd-sourced refinement of strong gravitational lens candidate samples by citizen scientists. Binary (lens/non-lens) classification by citizen scientists has been conducted previously, and here we extend such categorisation into `definite', `probable', `possible', and `non-lenses'. This grading is a required stage ahead of any strong lens sample publication and is usually carried out by (small) teams of researchers. We compare the responses of the volunteers to those of strong lens researchers and discuss the optimal strategy for lens classification and grading in future strong lens searches. Volunteers are found to be able to correctly identify systems of each grade, and their responses can be calibrated to be comparable to those of researchers. Grade posteriors, defined as the probability that a strong lens system classified by the volunteers is a certain grade, converge most rapidly for non-lens systems. We find that one researcher classification is equivalent to only 1.9 volunteer classifications when grading such systems. There is significant disagreement in the grading of intermediate-grade lens candidates amongst both volunteers and researchers. Moving towards calibrated lens probabilities for future lens searches would help to account for such subjectivity. If the Q1 lens search was rerun with volunteers performing lens grading (and corresponding calibration), a completeness of 79% for Grades A+B (corresponding to definite + probable lenses respectively) could be achieved with 41% purity prior to researcher inspection - this would correspond to an expected 12500 true lenses (i.e. excluding contaminants) in Euclid DR1.

title: Dust Survival in Lensed Quiescent Galaxies at $z>1$ Depends on How They Quench
summary: The interstellar medium of massive quiescent galaxies holds key clues to how they quench, yet remain poorly understood. Although dust is expected to be depleted rapidly ($\lesssim$100 Myr) after quenching, some quiescent galaxies host substantial dust reservoirs, raising the question of whether dust survives quenching or is replenished afterward. We present ALMA Band 6 continuum observations ($λ_{\mathrm{rest}}$$>$250$μ$m) of eight strongly-lensed, spectroscopically-selected quiescent galaxies at z$\sim$1-2.5 from the COOL-LAMPS and REQUIEM surveys, plus five archival REQUIEM systems. The sample spans more than two orders of magnitude in dust-to-stellar-mass ratio ($f_{\mathrm{dust}}<10^{-5}$ to $>10^{-3}$), and two galaxies host extended, resolved dust. Comparing $f_{\mathrm{dust}}$ with time since quenching, roughly half the sample, preferentially at higher redshift, is consistent with rapid quenching and harsh dust destruction, while lower-redshift, more slowly quenched systems are consistent with milder destruction, possibly reflecting an evolving dominant quenching mode. The two most dust-rich galaxies exceed even the mildest model destruction tracks, with J1201-3952 retaining the highest $f_{\mathrm{dust}}$ $\sim$1.8 Gyr after quenching. If these systems are truly quiescent, their dust masses approach maximum stellar yields, pointing to ISM grain regrowth and/or TP-AGB dust production. However due to our single-band continuum data, $f_{\mathrm{dust}}$ is uncertain ($\pm$0.3 dex systematic uncertainty from the unknown dust temperature) and we cannot rule out obscured star formation in these two galaxies. Our results suggest that dust survival depends on how galaxies quench: rapid, harsh quenching efficiently destroys dust, while slower, milder quenching can leave dust reservoirs that persist or are replenished long after star formation ceases.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 大质量宁静星系的星际介质为理解其如何淬灭提供了关键线索，但目前仍知之甚少。尽管预期尘埃在淬灭后会迅速耗竭（$\lesssim$100 Myr），但一些宁静星系仍保有可观的尘埃储库，这引出了尘埃是在淬灭过程中存活还是在之后被补充的问题。我们展示了来自 COOL-LAMPS 和 REQUIEM 巡天的八个位于 z$\sim$1-2.5 的强透镜、光谱选择的宁静星系的 ALMA Band 6 连续谱观测（$λ_{\mathrm{rest}}$$>$250$μ$m），以及五个档案 REQUIEM 系统。样本跨越超过两个数量级的尘埃与恒星质量比（$f_{\mathrm{dust}}<10^{-5}$ 至 $>10^{-3}$），且两个星系拥有延展的、可分辨的尘埃。将 $f_{\mathrm{dust}}$ 与自淬灭以来的时间进行比较，大约一半的样本（优先位于较高红移）与快速淬灭和剧烈尘埃破坏一致，而较低红移、淬灭较慢的系统与较温和的破坏一致，这可能反映了主导淬灭模式的演化。两个尘埃最丰富的星系甚至超过了最温和的模型破坏轨迹，其中 J1201-3952 在淬灭后 $\sim$1.8 Gyr 仍保有最高的 $f_{\mathrm{dust}}$。如果这些系统确实是宁静的，其尘埃质量接近最大恒星产额，指向 ISM 颗粒再生长和/或 TP-AGB 尘埃产生。然而由于我们的单波段连续谱数据，$f_{\mathrm{dust}}$ 存在不确定性（来自未知尘埃温度的 $\pm$0.3 dex 系统不确定性），且我们无法排除这两个星系中存在被遮蔽的恒星形成。我们的结果表明，尘埃存活取决于星系如何淬灭：快速、剧烈的淬灭高效摧毁尘埃，而缓慢、温和的淬灭则可留下在恒星形成停止很久之后仍存留或被补充的尘埃储库。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要的结论：尘埃存活取决于星系如何淬灭：快速、剧烈的淬灭高效摧毁尘埃；缓慢、温和的淬灭则可留下在恒星形成停止很久之后仍存留或被补充的尘埃储库。

title: Lessons from double-plane lenses for galaxy profiles, the Hubble tension, and the mass-sheet degeneracy
summary: Double-plane lenses, like single-plane lenses, are subject to the mass-sheet degeneracy, a fundamental limit to our knowledge of the deflector mass profiles from lensing. However, with a prior on the relative expansion history, unlike in the single-plane case, this degeneracy can be constrained with the modelling of lens images, without the need for time delays, velocity dispersion measurements or a prior on the Hubble constant $H_0$. We show that double-plane lenses are sensitive to a specific combination of the mass-sheet components of the two lens planes. Using literature values of the cosmological scaling factor from the double-plane lenses J0946 and AGEL0353, a measurement from the point-source images of J1721 (the ``Einstein zig-zag'' lens), and a reference value of $Ω_\mathrm{m}$, we show the constraints that can be placed on the mass-sheet component of each of these systems. We show that the additional information brought by images of a second source can improve measurements of $H_0$ from individual time-delay lenses by up to $\sim50\%$, depending on certain key assumptions. Using forecasted Euclid and LSST double-plane lens samples, we show that these samples will enable strong constraints on the population of mass sheets in lens galaxies. Such population constraints will have implications for a range of strong-lensing science applications, in particular in constraining $H_0$, dark energy, and the dark matter profiles of galaxies.

AI.motivation: 单平面与双平面引力透镜均存在质量片简并（mass-sheet degeneracy），这是从透镜观测推断偏转体质量剖面的根本限制。作者希望探究：在双平面透镜情形下，借助相对膨胀历史先验，是否无需时间延迟、速度弥散或H0先验即可打破该简并，并量化其对H0与质量片群体约束的价值。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 双平面透镜与单平面透镜一样，受到质量片简并的影响，这是我们从透镜效应中了解偏转体质量剖面的一个基本限制。然而，在相对膨胀历史有先验的情况下，与单平面情况不同，这种简并可以通过对透镜图像的建模来约束，而不需要时间延迟、速度弥散测量或哈勃常数 $H_0$ 的先验。我们表明，双平面透镜对两个透镜平面的质量片组分的特定组合敏感。利用双平面透镜 J0946 和 AGEL0353 的宇宙学缩放因子的文献值、来自 J1721（“爱因斯坦之字形”透镜）点源图像的测量值以及 $Ω_\mathrm{m}$ 的参考值，我们展示了可以对这些系统中每个系统的质量片组分施加的约束。我们表明，来自第二个源图像的信息可以将单个时间延迟透镜对 $H_0$ 的测量提高多达 $\sim50\%$，具体取决于某些关键假设。利用预测的 Euclid 和 LSST 双平面透镜样本，我们表明这些样本将能够对透镜星系中的质量片群体施加强约束。这种群体约束将对一系列强透镜科学应用产生影响，特别是在约束 $H_0$、暗能量和星系的暗物质剖面方面。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: Illustrative possibilities for the mass profiles in planes 1 and 2 of a double-plane lens, assuming \(\eta=1.021\) (our fiducial value for J1721), \(\zeta_{12}=0\) and both planes have been modelled with a power law mass profile, following Eq. (29) , (31) and (35) . If, in reality, plane 1 features a positive mass-sheet component, \(\zeta_{1}>0\) , which would imply a log-convex profile which grows increasingly flat as \(\theta\) increases relative to the modelled power law, the profile in plane 2 must be log-concave, growing increasingly steep as \(\theta\) increases (the scenario in red). If instead plane 1 features a negative mass-sheet component, this relationship is reversed (the scenario in blue).
figures.caption_zh: 图 2：双平面透镜平面 1 和平面 2 中质量剖面的示例性可能性，假设 \(\eta=1.021\)（我们对 J1721 的基准值）、\(\zeta_{12}=0\)，并且两个平面均已按照式 (29)、(31) 和 (35) 用幂律质量剖面建模。如果在现实中，平面 1 具有正质量片组分 \(\zeta_{1}>0\)，这意味着一个对数凸剖面，随着 \(\theta\) 相对于建模的幂律增加而变得越来越平坦，则平面 2 中的剖面必须是对数凹的，随着 \(\theta\) 增加而变得越来越陡峭（红色情景）。如果相反，平面 1 具有负质量片组分，则这种关系反转（蓝色情景）。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3: What we learn from observations of a double plane lens. Imaging constraints and a reference \(\eta\) value (i.e. the relative expansion history) provide a measurement of \(\zeta_{12}\) , fixing us to a line of degeneracy (as shown by the curved solid coloured lines), and thus limits the combination of lens profile shapes (with respect to the fiducial profile). While we do not fix the profile of either lens, we can restrict the combinations of the profiles of the two lenses. Requiring that \(\zeta_{1}=\zeta_{2}\) (shown as the black dotted line), or measuring time delays and comparing to a value of \(H_{0}\) (shown as the green dash-dotted line), would each fix the values of both \(\zeta_{1}\) and \(\zeta_{2}\) . Any disagreement between these constraints implies a flaw in one of their underlying assumptions.
figures.caption_zh: 图 3：我们从双平面透镜观测中学到了什么。成像约束和参考 \(\eta\) 值（即相对膨胀历史）提供了对 \(\zeta_{12}\) 的测量，将我们固定到一条简并线上（如弯曲的彩色实线所示），从而限制了透镜剖面形状的组合（相对于基准剖面）。虽然我们没有固定任一透镜的剖面，但我们可以限制两个透镜剖面的组合。要求 \(\zeta_{1}=\zeta_{2}\)（如黑色虚线所示），或测量时间延迟并与 \(H_{0}\) 的值比较（如绿色点划线所示），都将分别确定 \(\zeta_{1}\) 和 \(\zeta_{2}\) 的值。这些约束之间的任何不一致都意味着其基本假设之一存在缺陷。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4: What can be learnt from a double-plane system with time delays. A \(\tilde{H}_{0}\) measurement is sensitive to \(H_{0}\) and the mass profile in the foreground plane, while a \(\tilde{\eta}\) measurement is sensitive to the relative expansion history and the mass profiles in both planes. If you trust a certain fiducial cosmology, this has implications for the mass profiles of the two lens galaxies.
figures.caption_zh: 图 4：从具有时间延迟的双平面系统可以了解到什么。\(\tilde{H}_{0}\) 测量对 \(H_{0}\) 和前景平面中的质量剖面敏感，而 \(\tilde{\eta}\) 测量对相对膨胀历史和两个平面中的质量剖面敏感。如果你相信某个基准宇宙学，这对两个透镜星系的质量剖面有影响。

title: 3D dark matter map of the JWST COSMOS-Web field using diffusion-based generative priors
comment: 24 pages, 5 main figures, 6 extended data figures
summary: Mapping the three-dimensional distribution of dark matter is key to tracing the growth of cosmic structure. Two-dimensional weak lensing mass maps recover its projected distribution, but they blend structures at different distances along the line of sight. We reconstruct the three-dimensional matter distribution in the 0.54 deg$^2$ COSMOS-Web field using deep James Webb Space Telescope imaging, with an effective source density of 121 galaxies arcmin$^{-2}$ We combine a physical weak lensing forward model with a diffusion-based Bayesian generative prior learned from cosmological simulations, yielding a posterior distribution of the matter field across 20 lens planes to $z \simeq 2$, doubling the redshift reach of previous Hubble Space Telescope-based 3D reconstructions and approaching cosmic noon, an epoch of rapid galaxy growth. The reconstruction separates structures that overlap in projection and recovers non-Gaussian matter structure across a range of spatial scales, including over-densities associated with independently identified galaxy clusters that were not detected in earlier weak lensing maps. Posterior sampling quantifies the range of three-dimensional matter distributions allowed by the data, enabling a probabilistic visualization of the cosmic web while propagating uncertainties in its inferred structure. Null and simulation-based tests show that the recovered structures are supported by the lensing signal and are consistent with expectations from the fiducial $Λ$CDM cosmology. These results extend three-dimensional weak lensing mapping into the high-redshift, non-Gaussian regime and establish a route towards probabilistic mapping of the evolving cosmic web with current wide-field lensing surveys.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 绘制暗物质的三维分布是追踪宇宙结构生长的关键。二维弱透镜质量图能够恢复其投影分布，但会将沿视线方向不同距离处的结构混合在一起。我们利用詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜的深度成像，在0.54 deg$^2$的COSMOS-Web天区重建了三维物质分布，有效源密度为121 galaxies arcmin$^{-2}$。我们将物理弱透镜前向模型与从宇宙学模拟中学习得到的基于扩散的贝叶斯生成先验相结合，得到了跨越20个透镜平面直至$z \simeq 2$的物质场后验分布，将此前基于哈勃空间望远镜的三维重建的红移覆盖范围扩大了一倍，并接近宇宙正午——一个星系快速生长的时期。该重建分离了在投影上重叠的结构，并在多个空间尺度上恢复了非高斯物质结构，包括与独立识别出的星系团相关的超密度区域，而这些星系团在此前的弱透镜图中未被探测到。后验采样量化了数据所允许的三维物质分布范围，从而实现了宇宙网的概率化可视化，同时传播了其推断结构中的不确定性。零检验和基于模拟的检验表明，所恢复的结构得到透镜信号的支持，并与基准$Λ$CDM宇宙学的预期一致。这些结果将三维弱透镜制图推进到高红移、非高斯区间，并为利用当前宽视场透镜巡天实现演化宇宙网的概率化制图开辟了途径。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 我们的三维重建追踪了连续0.54 deg 2的COSMOS-Web天区直至\(z\simeq 2\)的物质分布，将此前三维弱透镜重建的红移覆盖范围扩展至接近宇宙正午，同时保留了编码暗物质晕组装及其与周围宇宙网联系的小尺度、非高斯区间的信息。在投影上重叠的物质结构沿视线方向被分离，包括与独立识别出的更高红移星系团相关的超密度区域，这些星系团在此前的HST弱透镜图中未被探测到，这得益于JWST观测的更長波长覆盖、高角分辨率和灵敏度。生成式贝叶斯框架进一步将三维质量制图所提供的信息扩展到单一重建场之外。对高维后验进行采样，可以量化物质结构在振幅、形态和径向定位方面的不确定性，并将其传播到派生观测量。因此，所得后验既提供了宇宙网的高分辨率三维视图，也提供了其允许结构的概率化描述。应用于Euclid和南希·格雷斯·罗曼空间望远镜预期提供的大得多的弱透镜数据集，该方法可以在显著更大的宇宙学体积上追踪宇宙网的演化，并利用物质场中超越传统两点透镜统计的非高斯信息。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1 : Three-dimensional posterior reconstruction of the COSMOS-Web matter distribution. Three perspective views of the inferred matter overdensity field, \(\delta\) , across the COSMOS-Web footprint and 20 lens planes spanning \(z\simeq 0.13-1.92\) . Columns show the same volume from three viewing directions. a. Posterior mean density field computed from 1,024 posterior realizations, emphasizing structures that remain coherent across the posterior ensemble. b. Posterior realization with the highest three-dimensional Pearson correlation with a template constructed from independently identified galaxy clusters Scognamiglio et al. (2026) . This selection is used only for visualization and does not enter the inference or subsequent statistical analyses. c. An unselected posterior realization drawn randomly from the same ensemble, illustrating realization-to-realization variation. Individual realizations retain sharper, higher-contrast structures than the posterior mean, while variations among them reflect posterior uncertainty in the amplitude, morphology and radial localization of the reconstructed matter distribution. Color indicates matter overdensity; separate color ranges are used for the posterior mean and individual realizations.

JWST posterior mean matter overdensity averaged over adjacent lens planes in five redshift intervals ( \(z=0.13\) – \(1.25\) ). Light blue/white and dark brown indicate overdensities and underdensities, respectively. Orange crosses mark galaxy clusters detected in the previous HST weak lensing mass map, whereas green triangles indicate JWST-only detections Scognamiglio et al. (2026) . Cluster positions and redshifts are independently determined and are not used in the reconstruction. These slices from a common angular footprint highlight the changing location and persistence of matter structures along the line of sight. All slices are displayed at the same angular resolution, corresponding to an increasing transverse physical scale with redshift. White squares (f \(-\) h) mark the lines of sight examined below. f–h. Posterior mean overdensity profiles from JWST (blue) and HST (orange) towards three X-ray groups from Gozaliasl et al. (2019) . Shaded regions show the mean \(\pm 1\sigma\) of 128 identically smoothed randomized-shape null reconstructions. Dashed lines mark the selected group redshifts; dash-dotted lines indicate other X-ray groups within 2.5 arcmin. The three examples were selected by inspection to illustrate the JWST–HST contrast.

figures.caption_en: Figure 3 : Comparison with the two-dimensional COSMOS-Web weak lensing mass map. a. Posterior mean convergence, \(\kappa\) , obtained by projecting the inferred three-dimensional matter distribution along the line of sight. b. Previously published COSMOS-Web 2D convergence map (referred as S+26; Scognamiglio et al. (2026) ), reconstructed directly from the JWST COSMOS-Web shear catalogue. c. Same two-dimensional convergence map as in b. , overlaid with red contours enclosing regions where the projected three-dimensional posterior mean in a. exceeds the 95th percentile of its positive convergence values. The two reconstructions use the same underlying JWST shear catalogue but distinct inference approaches and the two-dimensional map is not used to constrain the three-dimensional reconstruction. Their spatial correspondence shows that the dominant angular mass concentrations are recovered by both approaches.
figures.caption_zh: 图3：与二维COSMOS-Web弱透镜质量图的比较。a. 通过沿视线方向投影推断的三维物质分布得到的后验平均收敛度\(\kappa\)。b. 此前发表的COSMOS-Web二维收敛度图（称为S+26；Scognamiglio et al. (2026)），直接由JWST COSMOS-Web剪切目录重建。c. 与b.相同的二维收敛度图，叠加红色等值线，包围a中投影三维后验平均值超过其正收敛度值第95百分位的区域。两种重建使用相同的底层JWST剪切目录，但采用不同的推断方法，且二维图未用于约束三维重建。它们的空间对应关系表明，两种方法都恢复了主要的角向质量集中。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4 : Statistical significance of the reconstructed weak lensing signal. a. Angular band powers of the projected posterior mean convergence field (red) compared with the mean and 1 \(\sigma\) scatter of 128 randomized galaxy-shape null reconstructions (grey). The null reconstructions are obtained by independently randomizing the orientations of the observed galaxy ellipticities and rerunning the 3D reconstruction pipeline, thereby removing spatially coherent shear while preserving the measured ellipticity amplitudes and source sampling. Our posterior mean reconstruction exhibits excess angular power relative to the null, indicating a spatially coherent shear signal significantly above the shape-noise level. b. Bandwise signal-to-noise relative to the null ensemble. For each band, this is the difference between the posterior mean band power(red) and the null mean (grey) in a , in units of the null 1 \(\sigma\) scatter. c. Voxel significance, \(|\nu|\) , defined as the deviation of the posterior mean from the mean of the null reconstructions in units of their standard deviation at each voxel, as a function of lens-plane redshift. Red points mark the 25 pixels with the largest \(|\nu|\) in each plane, corresponding to the upper 0.5% of in-footprint pixels.
figures.caption_zh: 图4：重建弱透镜信号的统计显著性。a. 投影后验平均收敛度场的角向带功率（红色），与128个随机化星系形状零重建的均值和1\(\sigma\)离散（灰色）比较。零重建通过独立随机化观测星系椭率的取向并重新运行三维重建流程获得，从而在保留测量椭率振幅和源采样的同时去除空间相干剪切。我们的后验平均重建相对于零检验表现出过剩角功率，表明空间相干剪切信号显著高于形状噪声水平。b. 相对于零系综的逐带信噪比。对于每个带，这是a中后验平均带功率（红色）与零均值（灰色）之差，以零检验1\(\sigma\)离散为单位。c. 体素显著性\(|\nu|\)，定义为每个体素处后验平均与零重建均值之差以其标准差为单位，作为透镜平面红移的函数。红点标记每个平面中\(|\nu|\)最大的25个像素，对应天区内像素的上0.5%。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5 : Consistency of the reconstructed convergence power with the fiducial \(\Lambda\) CDM cosmology. a. Angular convergence band powers, \(C_{\ell}^{\kappa}\) , of the reconstructed COSMOS-Web field and 800 held-out Conicus3D realizations, compared with the fiducial \(\Lambda\) CDM prediction. Points and error bars show the mean and central 68% (16th–84th percentile) intervals across 1,024 posterior samples and 800 Conicus3D realizations, respectively. The continuous curve shows the fiducial theoretical spectrum; the binned prediction includes the same survey mask, mode-coupling and band-power operators applied to the reconstructed and simulated fields. b. Fractional band-power residuals of the COSMOS-Web reconstruction and held-out Conicus3D ensemble relative to the binned fiducial prediction. The reconstructed power is lower than the simulated mean on large angular scales but remains statistically consistent with the simulated ensemble when accounting for field-to-field variance and correlations between angular scales.

COSMOS-Web重建和留出Conicus3D系综相对于分箱基准预测的分数带功率残差。重建功率在大角尺度上低于模拟均值，但在考虑场间方差和角尺度之间的相关性后，仍与模拟系综在统计上一致。

figures.caption_en: Extended Data Fig. 1 : End-to-end reconstruction fidelity on held-out simulated fields. a. Ground-truth and posterior mean projected convergence maps for four randomly selected examples from the 16 held-out fields. b., c. Pearson correlation and root-mean-square error (RMSE), respectively, across the 16 light cones as functions of the Gaussian standard deviation \(\theta\) applied only to the posterior mean maps; the ground-truth maps remain at the native 0.6375-arcmin resolution. At native resolution, the median correlation is 0.70 and the median RMSE is 0.0199; neither metric improves with additional smoothing. Orange lines show field medians and error bars show 95% paired field-bootstrap intervals. d. figures.caption_en: Extended Data Fig. 2 : Redshift dependence of density-contrast recovery in held-out simulations. a. Standard deviation of the matter overdensity within the COSMOS-Web footprint as a function of mean slice redshift for 16 held-out synthetic fields. Lens planes are grouped into the five redshift intervals used for the tomographic reconstruction and a sixth higher-redshift interval containing the remaining lens planes. Ground-truth (blue) and posterior-mean reconstructed (orange) density fields are smoothed identically with a 1-arcmin FWHM Gaussian. title: Where the red rise stops: JWST/MIRI reveals a near-infrared turnover in the Little Red Dot Abell2744-QSO1
comment: 15 pages (main text), 9 figures (main text), 2 tables. Submitted to MNRAS
summary: Little Red Dots (LRDs) are compact sources with a blue rest-frame UV, a steep red optical continuum and, often, broad hydrogen lines. They have been interpreted as dense stellar systems, dust-reddened active galactic nuclei, or black holes embedded in dense, dust-poor gas, scenarios that are hard to tell apart in the rest-frame UV and optical. We present JWST/MIRI F770W and F1000W imaging of the triply lensed Abell2744-QSO1 at z=7.04, probing rest-frame 0.96 and 1.24um. QSO1 is unresolved, and its steep optical rise stops near rest-frame 1um. Up to 1.24um, a T~4450K blackbody, or a hotter one reddened by dust, describes the continuum, with no sign of the hot dust seen in most type-1 quasars. Our statistically preferred SED fits produce the red continuum with (3-4)x10^9 Msun of stars, over 100 times the dynamical limit on the host mass, and are therefore disfavoured. An accretion disc in a dense gas cocoon respects this limit but over-predicts the 1.24um flux by 5 sigma. Super-Eddington accretion models with a thermalising envelope reproduce the turnover, but only for a black hole ~2.5dex less massive than the dynamical estimate. For a dust-reddened accretion disc (A_V ~ 2 mag), dust at ~1200K can re-emit at most ~2 per cent of the absorbed luminosity, and most of it would have to emerge at ~70-600K, unless the dust covers only a small fraction of the sky. The dynamics favour an accretion-powered source, but our data cannot distinguish dust reddening from processing by dense gas. MIRI imaging at >18um could separate these scenarios.

title: A pocket of oxygen in a near-pristine galaxy at z=4.2: chemical inhomogeneity at 10-parsec scales in LAP2
comment: 12 pages (7 figures, 1 table). Submitted to A&A
summary: We aim to constrain the oxygen abundance, the ionizing properties, and the spatial structure of LAP2, a strongly lensed (with a magnification $μ$~50) oxygen-deficient galaxy at z=4.2 behind the galaxy cluster Abell 2744. We present new JWST/NIRSpec IFU PRISM observations (~13.6 hr) of LAP2, which we combine with archival JWST/NIRCam imaging. LAP2 is intrinsically extremely faint (M_UV=-12.7) and has a low stellar mass (M~$10^5~M_\odot$), comparable to that of massive star clusters. It consists of a compact core ($R_{eff}$~7 pc) embedded in a more diffuse emission (with $R_{eff}$~20 pc). Strong H$α$ emission (EW$_{\rm rest}\simeq880$ Å, $\logξ_{\rm ion}\simeq25.3$), a blue UV slope ($β_{\rm UV}\simeq-2.5$, down to $\simeq-3.1$ in the core), and a Balmer decrement consistent with no dust attenuation indicate a young ($\lesssim10$ Myr), dust-free burst. [OIII]$λ$5007 is not detected in the integrated spectrum, implying [OIII]/H$β\leq0.61$ ($3σ$) and, using an extrapolated strong-line calibration, $12+\log({\rm O/H})\leq6.4$ ($\lesssim0.5\%\,Z_\odot$). This places LAP2 among the most metal-poor galaxies known. Faint [OIII] emission is, however, detected in the core (with $\rm4σ$ significance), where we derive $12+\log({\rm O/H})\simeq6.6$ ($\sim1\%\,Z_\odot$). This difference can be explained either by local self-enrichment, requiring only $\rm \sim0.2\,M_\odot$ of newly synthesized oxygen, or by a higher ionization parameter in the core. The upper limit on HeII$λ$1640 (EW$_{\rm rest}<39$ Å, $3σ$) does not exclude a contribution from metal-free stars. LAP2 extends the census of spectroscopically confirmed EMPGs to star-cluster masses and to $M_{\rm UV}\approx-13$. Its location in a low-density region supports a scenario in which underdense environments preserve nearly pristine gas well after reionization.

title: Through Ups and Downs: the Transient Lensing Behaviour of SIDM halos undergoing Core Collapse
comment: 22 pages, 11 figures. Submitted for publication in MNRAS
summary: Self-interacting dark matter (SIDM) haloes can become extremely dense following gravothermal core collapse, motivating their use as explanations for unusually concentrated gravitational lenses. Using an emulator calibrated on gravothermal fluid calculations, we investigate whether increasing central density necessarily strengthens lensing. We follow initially Navarro-Frenk-White (NFW) haloes through core formation and collapse deep into the short-mean-free-path regime, and compute finite-source magnifications, critical curves, and source-plane lensing cross sections for isolated spherical haloes with elastic, velocity-independent self-interactions, including external shear in selected calculations. Lensing strength evolves non-monotonically: it initially decreases during core formation, rises during early collapse, and generally declines at later stages despite continued growth of the central density. This decline accompanies the emergence of a dense inner core whose mass and radius decrease within a more extended, lower-density core. Time-averaged enhancement relative to NFW haloes depends on the lensing statistic, halo concentration, and interaction cross section. Generalized NFW haloes with central cusps $ρ\propto r^{-γ}$ with $γ\geq 2$ always have larger lensing efficacies than core-collapsed SIDM haloes of equal mass and are therefore poor proxies, including in terms of the demographics (size and radial thickness) of arcs and Einstein rings. The core collapse stage at which SIDM haloes are optimal lenses coincides with the epoch at which the characteristic core surface density is close to critical, which typically occurs during the early stages of core collapse. These results demonstrate that central density alone is insufficient to characterize SIDM lensing and that its evolving mass distribution must be modelled explicitly.

AI.tldr: 自相互作用暗物质晕在核心坍缩后中心密度极高，但提高中心密度并不必然增强透镜效应：透镜强度随核心形成先减弱、早期坍缩时增强、后期又下降。中心密度不足以表征SIDM透镜效应，必须显式建模其演化质量分布。

AI.method: 使用基于引力热流体计算标定的emulator，追踪初始为NFW的晕经历核心形成并深入短平均自由程坍缩阶段；对孤立球对称晕（弹性、速度无关的自相互作用，部分计算含外部剪切）计算有限源放大率、临界曲线和源平面透镜截面，并比较不同透镜统计量、晕浓度和相互作用截面下的结果。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 自相互作用暗物质（SIDM）晕在引力热核心坍缩后可能变得极其致密，这促使人们用其解释异常集中的引力透镜。利用基于引力热流体计算校准的模拟器，我们研究了中心密度增加是否必然增强透镜效应。我们追踪初始为Navarro-Frenk-White（NFW）的晕经历核心形成并坍缩至短平均自由程区域深处，并计算了具有弹性、速度无关自相互作用的孤立球对称晕的有限源放大率、临界曲线和源平面透镜截面，在部分计算中包含了外部剪切。透镜强度呈非单调演化：在核心形成期间最初下降，在早期坍缩期间上升，并在后期阶段通常下降，尽管中心密度持续增长。这种下降伴随着一个致密内核心的出现，其质量和半径在一个更延展、密度更低的核心内减小。相对于NFW晕的时间平均增强取决于透镜统计量、晕浓度和相互作用截面。具有中心尖峰 $\rho\propto r^{-\gamma}$ 且 $\gamma\geq 2$ 的广义NFW晕在相同质量下总是比核心坍缩的SIDM晕具有更大的透镜效率，因此是糟糕的替代模型，包括在弧和爱因斯坦环的统计（大小和径向厚度）方面。SIDM晕成为最优透镜的核心坍缩阶段与特征核心面密度接近临界的时期重合，这通常发生在核心坍缩的早期阶段。这些结果表明，仅中心密度不足以表征SIDM透镜效应，必须显式建模其演化的质量分布。

title: A multi-epoch VLBI study of compact symmetric objects as contaminants in the search for milli-lenses
comment: 25 pages, 12 figures, submitted for publication in Astronomy & Astrophysics
summary: The Lambda Cold Dark Matter model predicts a high abundance of low-mass dark matter halos, which can be probed through milliarcsecond-scale gravitational lensing (milli-lensing) of background radio-loud active galactic nuclei (AGNs). The Search for MIlli-LEnses (SMILE) project aims to find these rare systems with Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI). However, compact symmetric objects (CSOs) can closely resemble milli-lenses in VLBI images and are the main contaminant in such searches. We aim to determine the nature of the nine remaining milli-lens candidates of the SMILE pilot study and to characterize their physical properties. We analyzed all available multi-epoch, multi-frequency archival VLBI data, new HSA and EVN observations, and single-dish and connected-element interferometer measurements. We tested the lensing hypothesis through the morphology and spectra of the sources, and characterized their kinematics, spatially resolved spectral indices, magnetic fields, and integrated spectra, using synchrotron self-absorption (SSA) and free-free absorption (FFA) models. We identify eight of the nine candidates as CSOs, four of them for the first time. Spectral index asymmetries between components and previously undetected emission connecting them rule out the lensing hypothesis. Only J0923-3435 remains ambiguous. For the CSOs with known redshifts, the lobes have equipartition magnetic fields of $\sim$20-320 mG and projected separations of $\sim$60-240 pc, and show no measurable expansion, implying kinematic ages of at least $\sim$50-950 yr. The integrated spectra of J0210-2213 and J2347-1856 favor an inhomogeneous external free-free absorber over homogeneous and inhomogeneous SSA models. Since CSOs will be the main contaminant in the full SMILE survey, applying this framework will provide the same constraints for a much larger sample of compact radio-loud AGNs.

AI.tldr: SMILE先导研究中9个毫角秒引力透镜候选体，经多历元多频VLBI与谱分析，8个被证认为致密对称天体（CSO）而非透镜，仅J0923-3435仍存疑。
AI.motivation: ΛCDM预言大量低质量暗物质晕，可通过背景射电噪AGN的毫角秒级引力透镜（milli-lensing）探测。但CSO在VLBI图像上与毫角秒透镜高度相似，是该搜寻的主要污染源，需甄别SMILE先导研究剩余9个候选体的性质。
AI.method: 分析全部可获取的多历元、多频档案VLBI数据，以及新的HSA与EVN观测、单天线和连结干涉阵测量；从形态与频谱检验透镜假设，并用同步辐射自吸收（SSA）与自由-自由吸收（FFA）模型刻画运动学、空间分辨谱指数、磁场与积分谱。

artifacts.abstract_zh: Λ冷暗物质模型预言存在大量低质量暗物质晕，这些暗物质晕可以通过对背景射电噪活动星系核（AGN）的毫角秒尺度引力透镜效应（毫透镜）进行探测。寻找毫引力透镜（SMILE）项目旨在利用甚长基线干涉测量（VLBI）找到这些稀有系统。然而，致密对称天体（CSO）在VLBI图像中可能与毫透镜非常相似，是此类搜寻中的主要污染源。我们旨在确定SMILE先导研究中剩余九个毫透镜候选体的性质，并表征其物理特性。我们分析了所有可用的多历元、多频率档案VLBI数据，新的HSA和EVN观测，以及单天线和互联干涉仪测量。我们通过源的形态和频谱检验了透镜假说，并利用同步辐射自吸收（SSA）和自由-自由吸收（FFA）模型表征了它们的运动学、空间分辨谱指数、磁场和积分谱。我们将九个候选体中的八个识别为CSO，其中四个为首次识别。成分之间的谱指数不对称以及先前未探测到的连接它们的辐射排除了透镜假说。只有J0923-3435仍然存在歧义。对于已知红移的CSO，其瓣具有约20-320 mG的均分磁场和约60-240 pc的投影分离，并且没有可测量的膨胀，意味着运动学年龄至少为约50-950年。J0210-2213和J2347-1856的积分谱更倾向于非均匀外部自由-自由吸收体，而非均匀和非均匀SSA模型。由于CSO将成为完整SMILE巡天中的主要污染源，应用该框架将为更大样本的致密射电噪AGN提供相同的约束。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要的AI结论：CSO将是完整SMILE巡天中的主要污染源；该分析框架可推广至更大样本的致密射电噪AGN，给出同等约束。
